§The Mamba-3 cache

Mamba3Cache is the cache that one Mamba-3 block keeps between calls. Mamba3Caches holds one cache for each (virtual) layer of a stack. Mamba3::zero_cache builds the cache of a fresh sequence.

A cache holds:

  1. State (ssm_bhpr): hₜ ∈ ℝ^{per_head_dim×state_rank} for each head, the compressed context.
  2. Frame cache (Mamba3FrameCache): the fields that the plant frame writes.
    • Tap FIFO (TapFifo): the B and the x of the last lag write positions, oldest first. With them, the β term of the next call rebuilds β Bₚ₋ₗₐ₉ ⊗ xₚ₋ₗₐ₉. The FIFO exists only when the TapPattern of the block has a β tap. It owns its layout: its zeros, and the docs of the slot order and of the decay pre-scale of x.
    • Cumulative rotation (RotationState): the rotation up to the last position, to continue the data-dependent rotation.
    • Positive-system fields: ln Λ of a Kalman gain and c of a tropical register, when the block has them.

Mamba-3 has no conv cache. It removes the short 1-D convolution of Mamba-2: the trapezoidal discretisation and the learnable B/C biases take its role (info/mamba-3/architecture-deltas.md).

§One cache for both pathways

One cache type serves both pathways (ADR-0003). In the middle of a sequence, single-SSD carries its accumulator h', which is different from the state h of double-SSD. But a cache exists only at a call boundary, and there the two are equal:

  • At a call boundary, the look-ahead term νₜ₊ₗₐ₉ is zero, so scaleₜ = γₜ for the last lag positions. The next call pays their second installment, from the tap FIFO.
  • With this substitution, the accumulator h'ₜ = αₜ h'ₜ₋₁ + scaleₜ Bₜ⊗xₜ is exactly the state hₜ = αₜ hₜ₋₁ + Σ_taps βₜ Bₜ₋ₗ⊗xₜ₋ₗ + γₜ Bₜ⊗xₜ.
  • The next call rebuilds the deferred β term from the tap FIFO, in the same way on both pathways.

The frame cache has the same meaning on both pathways. So a cache from a forward of one pathway continues its sequence on either pathway, and on step.

Structs§

Mamba3Cache
The cache that one Mamba-3 block carries between calls, on both pathways.
Mamba3Caches
The caches of a stack of Mamba-3 blocks.
Mamba3FrameCache
The frame cache: the part of a Mamba-3 cache that the plant frame writes. It has the same meaning on both pathways. Mamba3Cache holds it beside ssm_bhpr.
TapFifo
The tap FIFO of the trapezoid: the B and the x of the last write positions. A cache keeps them for the β taps of the next call. One slot holds one write position, and the slots are oldest first.
